_doc: Source for scripts/build_paste_bundles.py. Each bundle is one round: a self-contained PowerShell text the PFM copies from its raw page and pastes into Windows PowerShell ISE (F5). It writes the files, then opens the 90-161.Z Deployer (a window; text prompts if no window can open): steps run one by one with a live log and PASS/FAIL counts, then one results folder (Rounds\\<round>: a report file plus copies of the PDFs, to attach to one e-mail; zips do not cross the boundary) and a summary for the clipboard. It runs only the steps inside it (PFM 3A). Never hand-edit scripts/gov/paste/*.ps1: change this file or the sources and rebuild.

bundles.title: Round R07: Deployer window fix (R06 fell back to text mode); the report names any no-window cause; recycles Rounds\R06; renderer test r8
